This page is for you
Companion Animal Travel Desk Guide

If you are arranging travel for a pet, start here for the basic steps. The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways helps travelers prepare documents, carriers, and check-in details with steady, humane handling.

For large dogs, the fee depends on the travel plan and route. <<FACT F057>> The desk will confirm what applies before you arrive, and staff will tell you how to present the animal safely for screening and boarding.

Bird travel has its own packing limits, and the crate must stay within approved size and weight rules. <<FACT F065>> <<FACT F071>> Use a secure crate that gives the bird room to stand, turn, and rest without loose parts. Keep food, water, and absorbent lining in place as directed, and label the carrier clearly.

Travelers should also keep the pet calm before departure and bring any papers requested at check-in. If a pet seems distressed, tell staff right away so they can review the case and use the next calm step. Maple, for example, would be handled with care and checked in a way that protects both animal and traveler.

If you are unsure whether your animal fits the route, contact the desk early and share the details of the pet and crate. The team will walk through the options, note any restrictions, and help you avoid delays at the airport.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk before travel day.
